memory_candidates.content: In CSLib's birelational semantics (BForces, Birelational.lean), a total modal accessibility relation degenerates the box clause (forall w' >= w, forall u, r w' u -> u forces phi) to a world-independent global modality, so total-r models validate box a or not box a via a meta-level classical case split — hence total-r is5FC models cannot refute IS5 non-theorems, killing any construction that needs total-r countermodels for arbitrary non-theorems.
